30 Tribal Children Die in Madhya Pradesh; Opposition Criticizes Government

In Madhya Pradesh's Balaghat district, 30 tribal children have died, with 798 other sick individuals identified in the affected region. Congress leader Rahul Gandhi criticized the government, calling the situation a "complete failure" and demanding immediate investigation, treatment, and relief. The Leader of Opposition in the state assembly, Singhare, has written to the Prime Minister regarding the deaths.
